description: Gefahrenhinweise Erdfall- und Senkungsgebiete is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesamt für Geologie und Bergwesen Sachsen-Anhalt (LAGB). The topic of ‘Earthfall and reduction areas’ is intended to point to geogenous natural hazards caused by subrosion/carcination, without assessing them in detail. Coverage: Landesamt für Geologie und Bergwesen Sachsen-Anhalt (LAGB). The portal shows the English title as "Hazard statements Earthfall and sinking areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesamt für Geologie und Bergwesen Sachsen-Anhalt (LAGB). Its keywords include geogene Risiken, Senkung, LAGB Sachsen-Anhalt, sgd_Geogefahren, Gefahrenhinweise, geologische. The listing shows 2017-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
